title: Quiz: Welcome to Swift
description: Check what you have learned so far.

questions.question: What does print("Hi") do?

answers.text: It stores the text Hi for later.
It writes Hi out and moves to a new line.
It asks the person using the program to type Hi.

questions.why: print writes its text to the output and then starts a new line.

questions.question: In which order does Swift run these lines?
questions.why: Swift runs the lines of a program from top to bottom.

questions.question: Which of these is a comment?
questions.why: // starts a comment only outside a string. Inside quotes, it is just text.
